bandReport.notes: Items 46-83, contiguous, no gaps, no repeats. Item 46 opens p16-c1 whole and item 83 ends whole at the foot of p26-c2, so neither band edge is cut. All six pages are English. COLUMN CROPS: the automatic split is clean on every page; only the right-column item numbers peek in at the right edge of each c1 crop and the folio '-A )' at the left of each c2 crop. No workaround needed; p22.png was viewed only to confirm item 70's printed equation. Faint Hindi show-through ignored. FIDELITY / POSSIBLE DEFECT: item 70 prints the equation as 'y = 10 cos ωt 10' (a symbol between 'ωt' and the second '10' appears to be missing, e.g. '+' or a phase); transcribed as printed, a solver should treat it with care. Item 67 prints 'Select the correct answer using the code below' (no 'given'), as printed. Item 60 spells 'center' and item 83 says 'proportionately lesser', as printed. Item 59's titles are italic in the booklet; written plain with the printed ' : ' separator. Bold-italic 'not' in items 50, 56, 59 written as plain 'not'. CONTEXT: items 78-80 share the vowel-percentage table; their context is the survey description from the directions line (the leading 'Directions : The next three items are based on' removed) plus the table as a pipe table. Match lists 58 and 76 are pipe tables in the stem, codes written 'A-3, B-1, C-2, D-4'. No figure items in this band. CLASSIFICATION calls: 46 under General Mental Ability / Cubes and Cuboids; 77 (millets) under Geography / Crop Geography though it has a 2023 International Year of Millets flavour; 81 under Measures of Central Tendency (AM/HM); 83 under Demography and Census.
